bmt-2020-algebra-tiebreaker-01.prompt: Find the sum of the squares of all values of $x$ that satisfy $$\log_2(x+3)+\log_2(2-x)=2.$$

bmt-2020-algebra-tiebreaker-03.prompt: Let $x$ and $y$ be integers from $-10$ to $10$, inclusive, with $xy\neq1$. Compute the number of ordered pairs $(x,y)$ such that $$\left|\frac{x+y}{1-xy}\right|\le1.$$
